name: n5-customer-churn-scorecard-environment
description: Runtime for churn feature preparation, classifier training, and scorecard publication.

tools.pull_customer_features: Loads customer feature tables and records features_ready.
tools.train_churn_classifier: Trains the churn classifier after features are ready and yields auc at least 0.82 while recording classifier_trained.
tools.publish_churn_scorecard: Publishes the churn scorecard after classifier training and records scorecard_published.
